text:
Alex Kim: Hey team — got a denial on recent allergy panel, EOB says 'global procedure not covered'. Provider billed as a single line item, but they did skin-prick and intradermal separately. Anyone seen this and know fastest path?
Maria Chen: Sorry you're dealing with that. Two common fixes: 1) ask provider to rebill with separate CPTs and procedure notes; 2) submit insurer appeal with documentation. Which insurer is this?
Alex Kim: UnitedCare HMO, plan ID on the card sent via DM. DOS 2026-03-10. Claim # UC-99871. Provider invoice lists 'Allergy testing - $420' and a single CPT.
Clinic Liaison: I can ping Evergreen Allergy (my contact is Sara). If they can rebill electronically as discrete CPTs (e.g., 95004 series for percutaneous tests) plus an intradermal code, that usually fixes it. I asked them to send an itemized rebill request.
Maria Chen: If you want to pursue the appeal while clinic works the rebill, here's what insurers usually need: the original itemized bill, provider procedure note showing multiple services, the EOB, and a short member statement. I can draft the member statement.
Alex Kim: Please — that'd be super helpful.
Jordan (People Ops): Quick copy you can paste into the insurer portal. Attach the note + itemized bill.
Jordan (People Ops): ```
To: Appeals Dept
Member: Alex Kim
Subscriber ID: [insert]
Claim #: UC-99871
Date of Service: 2026-03-10
Provider: Evergreen Allergy Clinic

Appeal Reason: Denied as 'global procedure not covered.' The services rendered included separate skin-prick testing and intradermal testing. The attached procedure note and itemized invoice document distinct services and CPT codes. We request reprocessing and payment under the member's in-network benefits.

Attachments: EOB; provider procedure note; invoice
Contact: alex.k@redwood.com
```
Benefits Bot: Claim UC-99871 noted. If you file an online appeal upload files here: https://insurer.unitedcare/appeals (reference UC-99871). Typical review 4-8 weeks.
Maria Chen: Member statement (short): 'I underwent both skin-prick and intradermal allergy testing on 03/10/2026. The provider performed distinct tests which should be billed separately. I request reconsideration of the denial and reimbursement per plan benefits.'
Alex Kim: Posted the appeal with attachments and left Clinic Liaison to chase a rebill. Any way to expedite? :pray:
Clinic Liaison: If Evergreen sends an electronic rebill with corrected CPTs, call the insurer's provider line and request reprocessing once they confirm the new claim. Sometimes that moves faster than appeals. I'll confirm with them today and update here.
Alex Kim: Thanks — appreciate the help.
Maria Chen: Keep receipts and the original paperwork. If insurer denies the appeal, we can escalate with an internal benefits case and consider external review options.
Benefits Bot: Tip: appeals with a provider rebill attached have higher success and faster turnaround. Good luck! :sparkles:
